name: instabox
description: Track Instabox VMs, wake paused ones and run commands in them on demand, with no standing session.

api_keys.title: Instabox API keys
api_keys.description: One key per Instabox account/workspace, as label=key pairs separated by commas, e.g. personal=ibk_abc,work=ibk_def. Create each with `instabox keys create --name claude`. Stored in secure storage.
